title: Air Force pilots report drones up to 36,000 ft

tellings.quote: Air Force pilots have been reporting drones up to 36 drones up to 36,000 ft. There's there's like 30 or 40 reports over the last couple years

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a guest named Merrick says that US Air Force pilots have been reporting drones flying as high as 36,000 feet, with something like 30 or 40 reports over the past couple of years. If true, it would mean unknown craft are routinely showing up at airliner altitudes.
